Game Overview

Microplastics Feeding is a arcade title where satisfy your fish's craving for microplastics in this delightful 2D arcade adventure. Navigate the open ocean, munching on pollution while avoiding obstacles. Sharpen your timing and reflexes as you guide your finned friend to a cleaner marine world. It's a quirky quest to preserve ocean life with every nibble!
